description: Combined Sewer Overflows (CSOs): Beginning 2013 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The dataset represents the locations of combined sewer overflow (CSOs) outfall locations in NYS. It also includes overflow detection capabilities of CSO communities and overflow frequency data within a specified timeframe. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. Its tags are csos, sewage pollution, water quality, wet weather, sewage. The table has 20 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation. The portal shows 2020-11-11 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
